name: bukulapak
description: Aplikasi pembukuan & catatan kas UMKM offline-first: hitung untung/rugi, posisi uang riil (laci, bank, QRIS), kasbon & tagih WA, shift kasir, dan sinkron multi-perangkat.

scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply bukulapak --remote --config $([ -f wrangler.prod.jsonc ] && echo wrangler.prod.jsonc || echo wrangler.jsonc)
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config $([ -f wrangler.prod.jsonc ] && echo wrangler.prod.jsonc || echo wrangler.jsonc)
scripts.db:backup: mkdir -p backups && wrangler d1 export bukulapak --remote --config $([ -f wrangler.prod.jsonc ] && echo wrangler.prod.jsonc || echo wrangler.jsonc) --output backups/bukulapak-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).sql
scripts.cap:build: VITE_API_URL="https://bukulapak.solusikoding.com" npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:build: npm run cap:build && cd android && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab:build: npm run cap:build && cd android && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew bundleRelease

author: rizalahmaddd
